bootstrap.behavior: exact issue47 student.py feature/history/visible treatment and ordinal argmax
bootstrap.tie_break: lowest legal ordinal from original max(range(n), key=score)

policy.distribution: p0(a|I) * exp(f_theta(I,a)) normalized over current legal choices
policy.residual_initialization: exactly zero output; initial actor equals p0
policy.sampling: sample during training and primary evaluation; no greedy substitution
policy.single_action_state: probability 1; critic may update, actor mask 0

input_schema.normalization: issue49 normalize/mapped_action semantics with explicit Singing Bowl and unavailable-attribute extension
input_schema.categories: vocabulary.json; sorted namespaced enum table, index 0 is UNK
input_schema.numeric_normalization: sign(x) * log1p(abs(x)) / 10; each field has a separate availability mask
input_schema.missing_values: unavailable tag and mask 0; never infer zero or a simulator default
input_schema.set_pooling: sum; preserves multiplicity and is permutation invariant
input_schema.reward_groups: sum card entities within each group, then sum group entities; candidate receives its content-derived group embedding
input_schema.other_choices: sum candidate encodings excluding target candidate
input_schema.map_graph: directed public edges; two outgoing-neighbor sum message-passing layers; candidate receives destination node embedding
input_schema.map_coordinates: x / 6 and y / 15; boss-entry is a separate category
input_schema.history: retained in public evidence and issue47 bootstrap input; omitted from residual encoder
input_schema.availability_encoding: field-specific namespaced availability category for each allowlisted public projection field

architecture.kind: shared typed entity/group/directed-map encoder with candidate-conditioned actor residual and action-independent critic

training.loss_weighting: sum decision losses per game, averaged across 128 games; no per-episode length normalization; each minibatch sums its rows / 128
training.advantage: Monte Carlo ((actual terminal floor - current floor) / 60) - pre-update public value; batch-wide mean center and population standard-deviation scale with epsilon 1e-8; fixed before any preflight game
training.value_target: same Monte Carlo normalized floor progress
training.runtime_policy_rng: SHA256-derived from block, game seed and batch ID; per-game stream
training.optimizer_rng: separate deterministic stream derived from block seed, batch ID and epoch
training.environment_rng: native game seed only; game IDs never model inputs

preflight.resource_blocked_action: stop before formal training/evaluation; do not change cohort or updates

evaluation.primary: owner-paired ((floor_final_block1 + floor_final_block2)/2 - floor_p0); mean, signs, percentile 95% paired-owner bootstrap interval
evaluation.secondary: same paired contrast vs deterministic A and Expert

boundary_evidence.deck_and_relic_order: canonical multiset; remove indices and ordering to avoid draw-order leakage
